FRIENDLY, PROFESSIONAL ADVICE

With many years of experience in the upholstery trade, Kings Upholstery & Kings Marine Upholstery provide bespoke upholstery services for a range of clients, including the maritime industry, private individuals and commercial premises.

Email us now 
BESPOKE UPHOLSTERY SERVICES IN UPMINSTER

At Kings Upholstery, we are re-upholstery and repair specialists with over 30 years of experience. Relax in the comfort of your own home and we will come to you to show you our extensive range of fabric and leather samples and discuss your requirements.




We will transform your old furniture to look like new. We reupholster all items including piano stools and dining chairs.




Upholstery and Soft Furnishings




We offer an upholstery service where we can upholster your own items or we can make it for you. We make new cushion covers, scatter cushion covers, arm covers etc.  We also supply just cushion fillings in foam, feather or fibre to the size you require.




Marine Upholstery




We re-upholster boat seats and panels. We have a large selection of marine vinyls to choose from. We make custom made boat and engine covers and make covers for anything you want to the size you require.




Furniture




We manufacture fine quality sofas and chairs made exactly to the specification you require. We only use the best solid beech frames thus being able to give a lifetime guarantee. Select one of our high quality leathers, faux leather or suede or choose from our extensive range of fabrics.




Ski Racing Accessories




We make a wide range of ski racing accessories which include hole shots, ski bags, kit bags, fin protectors and wraps. These can be custom made in varying sizes and colours and can also be personalised with your name, boat name or logo.
